verdict.rationale: The only official SDK in the evidence is a client-side fraud data collection SDK for website pages (adyen-risk-docs-15). Programmatic risk work instead goes through REST APIs (Referrals and Disputes APIs) and the OpenAPI definitions in the official adyen-openapi GitHub repo, which points developers to Postman rather than language SDKs. missing for 10: official server-side language SDKs/client libraries covering the risk APIs (Referrals, Disputes, risk settings), SDK documentation and code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK-based integration.
